scientific_integrity.limitations: Not a full-entrywise positivity classification; not backward-Euler-started BDF2, TR-BDF2, variable-step methods, directed graphs or nonlinear flows. Existence rather than minimum star size at later stages.
scientific_integrity.originality_risk: Historical recurrence phase analyses and other differently named multistep oscillation results may cover an equivalent statement despite the inspected literature comparison.
scientific_integrity.proved: Exactly floor(k/2) simple positive scalar timestep zeros at stage k; at least ceil(floor(k/2)/2) separated negative hub-return bands on some finite unweighted star; sharp universal 12/13-vertex diagonal positivity boundary at k=2.
scientific_integrity.scope: Classical constant-step BDF2 with an exact semigroup starter; all stage indices k>=2; scalar real decay and connected symmetric weighted graph Laplacians.
scientific_integrity.verification: Analytical proof with 743 supplementary algebraic and finite numerical checks; no external mathematical validation.
